exact.Repeat-Penalty (0 = nicht senden, nur LM: Repeat penalty (0 = do not send, LM Studio only)
exact.Online-Erkennung erlauben, wenn das Offl: Allow online recognition if the offline language pack is missing
exact.Erkennung und Stimme sind die von Google: Recognition and voice are Google's (speech recognition and synthesis); the language follows the companion's reply language. Recognition is offline first (audio stays on the phone). If the language pack is missing (Google settings → Language → Offline speech recognition), audio goes to Google when online recognition is allowed.
exact.Whisper statt Google für das Mikrofon: Whisper instead of Google for the microphone
exact.Whisper läuft komplett auf dem Gerät, oh: Whisper runs entirely on the device, without Google and without network, and understands many languages. It recognizes after you stop speaking (no live text); recording ends after a pause or when you tap the microphone again. Larger models are more accurate but slower: "small" is a good start, "medium" is usually too slow on a phone.
exact.Sprache für Whisper (leer = Sprache des: Language for Whisper (empty = companion's language, auto = detect, else e.g. de)
exact.Das Feld legt fest, in welcher Sprache W: This field sets the language Whisper writes in. Empty: the companion's reply language; if you speak German to an English companion the text already comes out in English (Whisper translates). "auto" writes in the spoken language, a code like "de" always in that language.
exact.Das Verwalten der Sprachpakete braucht A: Managing language packs needs Android 13 or newer.
exact.Das Chat-Modell sieht keine Bilder. Ein: The chat model cannot see pictures. A small image model (e.g. SmolVLM, GGUF) describes an uploaded picture as text; the description then goes to the companion. Two files belong to it: the model and the matching mmproj file. Both are copied into the app storage and loaded only while describing.
exact.Vorgelesen wird, wenn oben „Antworten vo: Reading aloud happens when "Read replies aloud" is on above. You choose the voice per companion in the companion editor: either a system voice (Google speech output, needs installed voices) or a Piper voice (runs on the device without Google, see below). Without a choice the system voice of the language is used.
exact.Stimmen in der Google-Sprachausgabe lade: Download voices in the Google speech output, then press "Refresh" here.
exact.Unklare wörtliche Rede vom Server zuordn: Let the server assign unclear dialogue (AI)
exact.Gilt beim Vorlesen mit Stimmen für männl: Applies when reading aloud with voices for male and female speech (companion editor). The rules recognize the speaker from the speech tag, first names and paragraph changes. For the rest the app asks the server (chat model, e.g. LM Studio) in the background while it is already reading; until the answer arrives the narrator speaks. Short text excerpts (about 300 characters per quote) go to the server. Only in server mode, not with the model on the phone. Default: off.
exact.Wörtliche Rede beim Vorlesen von Dokumen: Dialogue when reading documents: the narrator speaks with the voice above (must be a Piper voice), quotes of men and women with these voices. The app recognizes who is speaking from the speech tag and first names.
exact.Schwankung der Betonung/Rhythmik (0.8 =: Stress/rhythm variation (0.8 = default, higher = more varied)
exact.Gilt nach dem Speichern (die Stimmen wer: Applies after saving (the voices are reloaded). To try, enter e.g. 0.9 and 1.1, save and listen to a voice; values that are too high make it stumble or hiss (back to 0.667 and 0.8).
exact.Piper-Stimmen sprechen komplett auf dem: Piper voices speak entirely on the device, even without Google speech output. "Choose voice folder…" takes a folder in the sherpa-onnx package format (vits-piper-…: .onnx, tokens.txt, espeak-ng-data once). A custom voice comes from training on a PC, see docs/EIGENE_STIMME.md. You choose the voice in the companion editor under "Voice"; only voices of the companion's language appear there. Quality low/medium runs smoothly, high is too slow on older phones.
exact.Mehrere Sprecher/Stimmungen, im Companio: Several speakers/moods, selectable individually in the companion editor. Listen:
exact.Kopiere das Modell (das kann bei großen: Copying the model (this can take a while for large models)…
exact.Täglich an das Update erinnern: Remind me of the update every day
exact.Die Nachricht nennt nur eine Kurzübersic: The message only gives a short summary (number of open to-dos), not their content. Tapping it opens the chat. The alarm is not exact to the second: while the phone is idle the message can come a few minutes late. It only applies after "Save".
exact.Zugriff erlaubt: Das Tagesupdate und die: Access granted: the daily update and the tools cal-add and cal-list use the phone's calendar. New appointments ask first (with weekday and date).
exact.Noch kein Zugriff. Ohne ihn zeigt das Ta: No access yet. Without it the daily update shows no appointments and cal-add/cal-list report an error to the companion.
exact.In mcp_servers.json kann ein Alias \"key: In mcp_servers.json an alias can have "keywords": ["regular expression", …]. If an expression occurs in your input, in the model's reply, in the text being read aloud or in a picture description, the tool runs without the model. An input with a match does not go to the model. The companion's approvals and the confirmation before tool calls apply. Caution: foreign texts (files, pictures) can also trigger tools this way. Default: off.
exact.Max. Werkzeugaufrufe pro Nachricht (0 =: Max. tool calls per message (0 = off)
exact.Ohne Kalender-Berechtigung bleiben Termi: Without calendar permission appointments are left out.
exact.Ohne Mikrofon-Berechtigung keine Sprache: No voice input without microphone permission.
exact.Benachrichtigungen sind nicht erlaubt (B: Notifications are not allowed (permission or system setting).
exact.Gleiches Format wie am PC. 'builtin': we: Same format as on the PC. 'builtin': weather or websearch runs in the app, 'url' talks to an MCP server over HTTP. The PC's Python servers are replaced by the built-in ones automatically. A remote control needs only {"server": "remote", "button": "P1"} (the label comes from the server, no codes here). A macro plays several tools: {"macro": ["tv-p1", 3, "tv-off"], "hint": "…"} (a number = pause in seconds).
exact.Liest die Werkzeuge des laufenden Server: Reads the tools of the running server (for a remote control: all buttons with their labels) and inserts them above as short aliases. Existing aliases stay unchanged; then check and "Save & reload".
exact.Kein Server gestartet (erst eine Konfigu: No server started (save a configuration with a server first).
exact.Bisherige Schlüsselwörter dieser Werkzeu: Existing keywords of these tools will be replaced.
exact.CSV oder Excel (.xlsx), eine Zeile je Wo: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), one row per word: word;tool;parameter1;parameter2;… The word is lowercased, duplicates are dropped, rows without a tool are ignored. Words with the same tool and parameters are merged into one expression; the parameters are fixed arguments. The existing keywords of the tools in the list are replaced. It is switched on under Settings.
exact.Gespeicherte Geheimnisse stehen oben (de: Saved secrets are listed above (the value stays hidden). The fields below are only for another secret or to replace an existing one (same name).
